findings.problem: “Held cold it can haze without tasting any different”: no source says tea cream leaves the taste unchanged.
findings.change: Cut to “held cold it can haze”; the watch line carries the tea cream test.

findings.problem: The right option was 56 characters against 42 to 44 and the only “No”: a length clue.
findings.change: Lengthened two distractors: “Yes: the sugar in the brine candies the skin like a glaze” (57) and “Faintly: the tea leaves a lemony sweetness in the meat” (54).

findings.problem: The lower bound of 1 to 2 cups sugar per gallon rested on one forum post, not two sites.
findings.change: Checked by search: a magazine recipe reprinted on a forum gives 1 to 1 and three quarter cups and a sugar guide gives 1 to 2 cups, so the range stands; the forum thread is added to sources.
